title: GenerateTaxSummaryPayload
description: Payload for the GENERATE_TAX_SUMMARY intent. Requests a tax-ready summary of transactions and deductions for a tax period and jurisdiction.

tax_period.description: Sub-period within tax_year. Default full year.

jurisdiction.description: Tax jurisdiction code (e.g. 'US-FED', 'US-NY', 'GB', 'DE'). Multi-jurisdiction filings request separate summaries per jurisdiction.

format.description: What kind of summary to produce.

include_supporting_documents.description: Whether to bundle receipt/invoice references with the summary. True for audit packs.

delivery_destination.description: Where to put the output (e.g. 's3://tax-archives/2026/', 'email:cpa@firm.com'). For external destinations, Privacy review applies.

purpose.description: Reason — e.g. 'CPA review for filing', 'audit defense pack'.
